sections.principal_risks: Principal risks and uncertainties The company provides trichological treatments and has taken steps to minimise the risk to trading in the event of a disruption. The company purchases products supplied to patients and might be adversely affected in the event of disruption to the supply chain. The directors have ensured that the company carries a reasonable level of stock to ensure that the company could continue to trade with minimum disruption. Due to Brexit the company has agreed to pay certain supplier upfront to hold stock at their premises for the company and deliver when needed to avoid any delays in obtain stock. The company has a normal level of exposure to price, liquidity and cash flow risks arising from trading activities which are conducted in sterling. The company does not enter into any formal hedging arrangements. On behalf of the board Marilyn Harris Director 19 December 2025 THE BELGRAVIA CENTRE LIMITED
